requires.label: Colorado residency required for Qualified Charity Care Program and Hospital Discounted Care
requires.quote: Applicant must be a Colorado resident. An applicant is a Colorado resident if they currently live in Colorado and intend to remain in Colorado.

rules.label: Qualified Charity Care Program: up to 100% discount for adjusted FPL at or below 250%
rules.quote: Discounts are available to patients whose adjusted income is at or below 250% of the FPL.

rules.label: WeCare: discount for adjusted FPL between 250% and 350%
rules.quote: Applicants who are over the income threshold for the Qualified Charity care Program whose adjusted household income is between 250% and 350% of the FPL.

rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care: up to 100% discount for FPL at or below 250%

payment_plan.quote: Payment plans that are established to pay the bills may not exceed four (4) percent of the patient's monthly household income.

notes: AGB rate is used for certain emergency services for non-residents under WeCare.

Excluded services include experimental/non-USFDA approved treatments, nursing home care, elective non-medically necessary surgeries, chiropractic, court ordered procedures, non-urgent dental, abortions except where required by law, cosmetic surgery, mental health services as a primary diagnosis, CU Sports Medicine services.
For WeCare, applicants must be screened for Medicaid/CHP+/Medicare and provide denial letter if applicable.
Multiple discounts are not allowed: financial assistance discount cannot be combined with employee discount, Medical Staff discount, or Self-Pay pricing discounts.
For bills from health care professionals, payment plan limit is two (2) percent of monthly household income.
Once 36 payments have been made, the remainder of the bill is forgiven and collection activities cease.
req_colorado_residency_for_qccp_and_hdc may leave out a condition: Colorado residency required for QCCP and HDC but not for WeCare (which allows non-residents for emergency services)
